data.title: Habtoor Grand Residences
data.about:
Step into a world of exclusivity at the Habtoor Grand Residences in Dubai Marina, a prestigious project by Al Habtoor Group. Spanning 50 levels with a ground floor, this development is a testament to luxury and elegance. 

Choose from an exquisite range of 2 to 4-bedroom apartments, 3 to 4-bedroom townhouses, and expansive 5-bedroom penthouses. Each home in Habtoor Grand Residences boasts stunning views of the sparkling sea, Bluewaters Island, Palm Jumeirah, and the scenic Dubai Marina, with sizes ranging from 2,023 sq. ft to a generous 6,738 sq. ft. Experience grandeur with roomy interiors and mesmerizing sea vistas. 

The residents can also enjoy access to the exceptional amenities of Al Habtoor Grand Resort. Conveniently situated near King Salman Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud St, Habtoor Grand Residences Address provides excellent connectivity across the emirate and direct beach access, making Habtoor Grand Residences a crown jewel in the realm of Al Habtoor City real estate development.

characteristics_module.title: Luxury Redefined at Habtoor Grand Residences
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Situated within the prestigious 5-star Al Habtoor Grand Resort Hotel in JBR.
  • Exclusive Beach Access: Direct entry to pristine beaches.
  • Elegant Structure: Majestic G+49 building.
  • Premium Residences: Offering 2, 3, 4BR apartments, and 5BR townhouses & penthouses.
  • Spacious 2BR Units: Starting at around 11M with expansive layouts across all types.
  • Attractive Payment Plan: Favorable 60/40 payment structure.
  • Spectacular Views: All units boast views of the sea, Bluewaters, Palm Jumeirah, and Dubai Marina.
  • Access to Hotel Amenities: Enjoy the luxury and convenience of hotel facilities.
  • Exclusive Residential Use: All units are purely residential.
  • Lifestyle Benefits: Direct access to luxurious beach clubs, gourmet restaurants along the Gulf, and a vibrant embankment.
  • Premium Services Available: A la carte services including concierge, security, housekeeping, maintenance, and 24/7 reception.

location_tile.title: Premium Living at Habtoor Grand Residences in Dubai Marina
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Positioned in the heart of Dubai Marina, the Habtoor Grand Residences stand as a testament to luxury living. Dubai Marina, known for its comprehensive infrastructure, is home to the Habtoor Grand Residences by Al Habtoor. These residences in Dubai Marina offer easy access to the emirate's core, enhanced by the close proximity to King Salman Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud St. This prime location near the Al Habtoor Grand Resort in Dubai Marina, coupled with the area's rich offerings, makes it an ideal place for luxury and convenience.

  • The Walk JBR 10 mins
  • Dubai Harbour 10 mins
  • Dubai Marina 12 mins
  • Palm Jumeirah 15 mins
  • Burj Al Arab 20 mins
  • Bluewater Island 20 mins
  • Dubai Mall 25 mins
